newsitem.title: DUBAI: Dubai Investment plans first private power plant.
newsitem.headline: Dubai Investment plans first private power plant.

text.p: Dubai Investment Co is planning to build the first private power plant in the United Arab Emirates in Dubai's Jebel Ali Free Zone, its general manager said in remarks published on Monday.
Al-Khaleej newspaper quoted Khalid bin Kalban as saying the first phase of the plant, with capacity of 60 megawatts, would cost about 60 million dirhams ($16.3 million).
The second phase, adding another 60 megawatts of capacity, would cost another 60 million dirhams.
Kalban did not say when work on the plant, which would cover an area of 35 sq km (22 sq miles), would start.
He said his company was currently discussing offers from U.S., German and British firms to start the project.
The oil-rich UAE is studying ways to give the private sector a bigger role in its economy, and in particular in its electricity and water utilities.
